entries.title: [Series] The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
entries.description: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
